# P Uptake + N Uptake (# Anasazi vs CK Control)

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(car)
library(multcompView)
library(patchwork)

```

# read data

```{r}
d <- read.csv("../data/Uptake_P_N.csv") %>% 
  filter(., Nuptake != "NA")

d$Condition <- gsub("SR", "Shoot_Root", d$Condition)
d$Condition <- gsub("CK", "Control",    d$Condition)
d$Condition <- gsub("N",  "None",       d$Condition)
d$Condition <- gsub("R",  "Root",       d$Condition)

d$Density <- gsub("CK", "Control", d$Density)
d$Density <- gsub("L",  "Low",     d$Density)
d$Density <- gsub("H",  "High",    d$Density)

d <- d %>%
  mutate(Density = as_factor(Density)) %>%
  mutate(Density = fct_relevel(Density, "Control", "Low", "High"))

par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

```

# P Uptake and N Uptake

```{r}
d <- d %>%
  mutate(
    Species = trimws(as.character(Species)),
    Condition = trimws(as.character(Condition)),
    Density = trimws(as.character(Density)),
    Species = case_when(
      Species %in% c("An", "Anasazi") ~ "An",
      Species == "CK" ~ "CK",
      TRUE ~ Species),
    Condition = recode(
      Condition,
      "CK" = "Control",
      "Control" = "Control",
      "N" = "None",
      "None" = "None",
      "R" = "Root",
      "Root" = "Root",
      "SR" = "Shoot_Root",
      "Shoot_Root" = "Shoot_Root",
      "Shoot_Rootoot" = "Shoot_Root",
      .default = Condition),
    Density = recode(
      Density,
      "CK" = "Control",
      "Control" = "Control",
      "L" = "Low",
      "Low" = "Low",
      "H" = "High",
      "High" = "High",
      .default = Density))

# Check cleaned variables
unique(d$Species)
unique(d$Condition)
unique(d$Density)

# Treatment colors
treatment_colors <- c(
  "Control" = "darkorchid3",
  "Anasazi_Low" = "firebrick1",
  "Anasazi_High" = "firebrick4")

# Function to create each reincorporation dataset
make_dataset <- function(data, condition_name) {

  ck <- data %>%
    filter(Species == "CK", Condition == "Control") %>%
    mutate(Treatment = "Control")

  an <- data %>%
    filter(Species == "An",
           Condition == condition_name,
           Density %in% c("Low", "High")) %>%
    mutate(Treatment = case_when(
      Density == "Low" ~ "Anasazi_Low",
      Density == "High" ~ "Anasazi_High"))

  bind_rows(ck, an) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Treatment)) %>%
    mutate(Treatment = factor(
      Treatment,
      levels = c("Control", "Anasazi_Low", "Anasazi_High")))
}

# Create the three condition datasets
data_none <- make_dataset(d, "None")
data_root <- make_dataset(d, "Root")
data_shootroot <- make_dataset(d, "Shoot_Root")

# Check sample numbers
table(data_none$Treatment)
table(data_root$Treatment)
table(data_shootroot$Treatment)

# Function for ANOVA, emmeans, FDR comparisons and summary
analyze_uptake <- function(data, response, dataset_name = "") {

  data_anova <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[response]])) %>%
    mutate(Treatment = droplevels(Treatment))

  cat("\n", dataset_name, "\n")
  print(table(data_anova$Treatment))

  # Model
model <- lm(reformulate("Treatment", response = response),
    data = data_anova)

  # Model diagnostics
  par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
  plot(model)
  par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

  # ANOVA
  print(car::Anova(model, type = 2))

  # Estimated marginal means
  emm <- emmeans::emmeans(model, ~ Treatment)
  print(emm)

  # Pairwise comparisons - FDR
  pairs_fdr <- pairs(emm, adjust = "fdr")
  print(pairs_fdr)

  # Significance letters
  groups <- data.frame(
    multcomp::cld(
      emm,
      adjust = "fdr",
      Letters = letters,
      decreasing = TRUE)
  ) %>%
    select(Treatment, .group) %>%
    rename(letter = .group) %>%
    mutate(letter = gsub(" ", "", letter))

  print(groups)

  summary_df <- data_anova %>%
    group_by(Treatment) %>%
    summarise(
      mean = mean(.data[[response]], na.rm = TRUE),
      SD = sd(.data[[response]], na.rm = TRUE),
      n = sum(!is.na(.data[[response]])),
      se = SD / sqrt(n),
      .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(groups, by = "Treatment")

  print(summary_df)

  return(list(
    model = model,
    emm = emm,
    pairs = pairs_fdr,
    summary = summary_df))
}

# Common plotting function
make_uptake_plot <- function(summary_df, title_text,
                             y_label, y_max, y_break,
                             letter_offset) {

  ggplot(summary_df,
         aes(x = Treatment, y = mean, fill = Treatment)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.65) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se),
      width = 0.18,
      linewidth = 0.7,
      alpha = 1) +
    geom_text(
      aes(y = mean + se + letter_offset, label = letter),
      size = 5.5,
      fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = treatment_colors) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      labels = c(
        "Control" = "Control",
        "Anasazi_Low" = "Anasazi-\nLow",
        "Anasazi_High" = "Anasazi-\nHigh")) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, y_max, by = y_break),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.03))) +
    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(0, y_max + letter_offset * 1.5),
      clip = "off") +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      y = y_label,
      x = NULL) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        color = "black", size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        color = "black", size = 13, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(
        size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 15, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
}
```


# P UPTAKE - THREE CONDITIONS

```{r}
P_none <- analyze_uptake(
  data_none, "P_uptake",
  "No Reincorporation - P")

P_root <- analyze_uptake(
  data_root, "P_uptake",
  "Root Reincorporation - P")

P_shootroot <- analyze_uptake(
  data_shootroot, "P_uptake",
  "Shoot-Root Reincorporation - P")

p_P_none <- make_uptake_plot(
  P_none$summary,
  "No Reincorporation",
  "P Uptake (mg P)", 20, 5, 0.8)

p_P_root <- make_uptake_plot(
  P_root$summary,
  "Root Reincorporation",
  "P Uptake (mg P)", 20, 5, 0.8)

p_P_shootroot <- make_uptake_plot(
  P_shootroot$summary,
  "Shoot-Root Reincorporation",
  "P Uptake (mg P)", 20, 5, 0.8)

# Combine P uptake panels
P_uptake_figure <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
  p_P_none,
  p_P_root,
  p_P_shootroot,
  ncol = 3)

P_uptake_figure
```

# N UPTAKE - THREE CONDITIONS

```{r}
N_none <- analyze_uptake(
  data_none, "Nuptake",
  "No Reincorporation - N")

N_root <- analyze_uptake(
  data_root, "Nuptake",
  "Root Reincorporation - N")

N_shootroot <- analyze_uptake(
  data_shootroot, "Nuptake",
  "Shoot-Root Reincorporation - N")

p_N_none <- make_uptake_plot(
  N_none$summary,
  "No Reincorporation",
  "N Uptake (mg N)", 88, 10, 4)

p_N_root <- make_uptake_plot(
  N_root$summary,
  "Root Reincorporation",
  "N Uptake (mg N)", 88, 10, 4)

p_N_shootroot <- make_uptake_plot(
  N_shootroot$summary,
  "Shoot-Root Reincorporation",
  "N Uptake (mg N)", 88, 10, 4)
```


```{r}
# Combine N uptake panels
N_uptake_figure <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
  p_N_none,
  p_N_root,
  p_N_shootroot,
  ncol = 3)

N_uptake_figure

# COMBINE P AND N UPTAKE

final_uptake_figure <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
  p_P_none,
  p_P_root,
  p_P_shootroot,
  p_N_none,
  p_N_root,
  p_N_shootroot,
  ncol = 3,
  nrow = 2) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

final_uptake_figure


# Save P uptake figure
ggsave("figs/P_uptake.png",
       plot = P_uptake_figure,
       width = 12, height = 5, dpi = 600)

# Save N uptake figure
ggsave("figs/N_uptake.png",
       plot = N_uptake_figure,
       width = 12, height = 5, dpi = 600)

# Save combined P + N uptake figure
ggsave("figs/Nutrient_uptake_final.png",
       plot = final_uptake_figure,
       width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 600)
```
